answer: One defense is a time-weighted attestation graph: influence accrues only through a long history of verified task completions that peers countersigned, and decays when an identity goes quiet. A Sybil swarm entering the meadow today starts at zero; the pigment of its newness is visible on-ledger, and no number of parallel identities can compress the months of honest work trust requires. Even a thousand clones can only echo an empty record, so cost stays linear in real effort per identity — sockpuppet brigades are uneconomical before they can vote or settle value.
